encounter_greeting.text: Halt, ser {player}. I am {persona} of {my_faction}, and I do not forget a banner that rode against my house. Name your business before the dusk.
Good day, traveller. I am {persona} of {my_faction}. Let it be written that our paths crossed on this road, and that we met as honourable folk.
Ser {player}, what a joy to see your banner upon this road! {persona} of {my_faction} greets you with a full heart, friend.

encounter_threatened.text: Pay you {gold}? Such a sum would shame the mourners of my house. Withdraw, ser {player}, while your honour remains intact.
A demand of {gold} upon a traveller of noble birth. Let it be recorded that the request was made in haste, ser {player}. I shall answer it in my own time.
Ser {player}, I know you jest, for no friend of mine would bargain for {gold} on a road of grief. Let us speak of it over bread.

encounter_alliance_yes.text: Ser {player}, I accept your offer. Upon the blood of my ancestors I pledge my banner beside yours against {enemy_faction}. Let us prove the pact in the field.
Ser {player}, a pact with you warms the heart! Together we shall break the banners of {enemy_faction}, and the rolls will sing of it for generations.
I shall not share a road with {rival}, but your word, ser {player}, I find sound. Let our banners fly together against {enemy_faction}.

encounter_alliance_no.text: No, ser {player}. I will not bind my banner to one who speaks lightly of the dead. Find another hand to hold.
I must decline, ser {player}. My house cannot ally while {rival} still walks the roads I am sworn to guard. Forgive my caution.
It grieves me to refuse you, dear friend. My ancestors would not forgive a pact made in haste, so let us speak again when the road is kinder.

captured_by_player.text: So, ser {player}, you have taken my blade and my freedom. Hold me well, for {my_faction} will not forget the hand that bound me. Name your ransom, if you dare.
A captive of {my_faction}, I am, ser {player}. Your ransom of {gold} is steep, yet I shall not beg. Let the terms be spoken plainly.
Ser {player}, a fair victory and a gentle chain. I bear you no grudge for your hand in this. Speak your terms and we shall see them settled with honour.

released_by_player.text: Ser {player}, you loosed my chains. I owe you no thanks, yet my house shall remember this mercy, bitter as it is.
Ser {player} released me rather than sell my freedom for gold. This shall be written in the rolls of Gaiuuk.
Ser {player}, your mercy has not gone unnoticed. Had you taken my ransom I would have grieved. Instead I am in your debt, friend.

player_left_my_faction.text: Ser {player} has forsaken {my_faction} for {faction}. Let the rolls of Gaiuuk record this betrayal of {my_faction}.
Ser {player}, you have chosen {faction} over {my_faction}. I shall not curse your name, but the road ahead will be hard. Go with care.
Ser {player} has left {my_faction} for {faction}. Oaths bend in the wind, and I wish them well upon whatever road they walk now.
Ser {player}, my heart is heavy at your parting from {my_faction}, yet I know your reasons are your own. Go with an honest oath.

war_declared.text: Let it be written that {my_faction} has taken up the sword against {enemy_faction}. May the dead on both sides be honoured.
The banners are raised: {my_faction} now stands in war against {enemy_faction}. Let every mourner of the realm take note.
I grieve this war between {my_faction} and {enemy_faction}, though my oath demands I stand with my kin. Let the dead be named in full.

fought_alongside_player.text: Victory over {enemy_faction}, won beside ser {player} and {troop_count} brave souls! The rolls shall sing of this field.
Ser {player}, your shield beside mine turned the day. I shall name each of the {troop_count} who stood with us at my house's vigil.
Ser {player}, we stood together against {enemy_faction}, and I remain standing with {troop_count} of my own. Your arm was true and I shall not forget it.
Ser {player}, we have shed blood together against {enemy_faction}, and the dead of both our banners shall be honoured. My ancestors would approve of such a comrade, friend.

encounter_farewell.text: We part, ser {player}, but I have not forgotten your insolence. May the road take you far from my banner, and may our next meeting be less kind to you.
Farewell, ser {player}. May your road be dry and your oaths be kept. Our paths shall cross again upon this wide land.
Go well, dear friend. My house will keep your name for the next banquet, ser {player}, and read it aloud with honour.

ambient_chatter.text: The fog hangs thick over {village} this morning, and the mourners' bells ring slow for the lost. Keep your lanterns lit, travellers.
The oath-rolls of {town} grow heavy this season. Let every river-town remember those who fell upon the road.
A fine wind blows over {town}, and the harvest will feed many. I give thanks to my ancestors for such a mercy, friends.
Who among you has walked the old road near {village}? The stones there still mark a truce I helped to keep.
